description: bf16 [10]: large magnitudes and tails in bf16.
reference: F.gelu(x, approximate="tanh") in f64, rounded once to the dtype
notes: x = -5, -6 and -10 are left out: at -5 and -6 torch's own bf16 kernel misses rtol 1e-2 (1 + tanh cancels in f32), and from about -6.2 on even torch's f64 result is 0 (1 + tanh(u) cancels in f64), while the true value (about -1.2e-37 at -10, which Polypous's sigmoid form gives) is a normal bf16 number. f16/bf16 compute in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8). out is computed in f64 from the inputs and params and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
